summary: Software Engineering Lead and Architect with 10+ years shipping event-driven distributed systems across healthcare ML, fintech, energy access, and government-scale infrastructure. Polyglot across Python, Java, C#, Rust, TypeScript, Go, Kotlin, Swift, and Clojure — with hands-on .NET 10 / ASP.NET Core fintech work (PesaCore) bridging the .NET 4.5 / Windows Server era at Veracode to the modern LTS ecosystem. Founded Deveric mentorship initiative (15+ engineers mentored) and hold 80+ validated technical certifications.
